scenarios.label: SCENARIO A — EASY (BAY OF BENGAL)
scenarios.description: Unambiguous single candidate test case where MV Konkan Pride aligns with release time, origin envelope, and fairway heading.

scenarios.label: SCENARIO B — AMBIGUOUS (ARABIAN SEA)
scenarios.description: Ambiguous multi-candidate scenario in dense shipping corridor where multi-attribute weighting isolates top vessel.

scenarios.label: SCENARIO C — DECOY / WRONG NEAREST VESSEL
scenarios.description: Critical test case demonstrating why Marine Trace does NOT naively choose the nearest vessel: Decoy MV Coastal Runner (nearest in distance, but 8.5h late, opposing course) ranks #3, while True Source MT Sagar Ratna (synchronous time, aligned course) ranks #1.
